ancestral_empowerment.text_zh:
目标忍者攻击行动牌获得+1力量。
抽一张牌。
ancestral_empowerment.text_en:
Target Ninja attack action card gains +1{p}.
Draw a card.

ancestral_harmony.text_zh:
本回合你的具有连击的攻击获得+1力量。
放逐你牌库顶的一张牌。若其具有连击，本回合你可以使用它。
再动
ancestral_harmony.text_en:
Your attacks with combo get +1{p} this turn.
Banish the top card of your deck. If it has combo, you may play it this turn.
Go again

art_of_the_dragon_blood.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若其为龙裔，它获得再动，且本回合你使用的接下来3张龙裔牌使用费用减少1点资源。
art_of_the_dragon_blood.text_en: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, it gets go again and the next 3 Draconic cards you play this turn cost {r} less to play.

art_of_the_dragon_claw.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若其为龙裔，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其军械库中的所有牌。”
art_of_the_dragon_claw.text_en: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, it gets "When this hits a hero, destroy all cards in their arsenal."

art_of_the_dragon_fire.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若其为龙裔，对任意目标造成2点伤害。
art_of_the_dragon_fire.text_en: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, deal 2 damage to any target.

art_of_the_dragon_scale.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若其为龙裔，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制的一件装备上放置一个-1防御指示物。然后若其防御为0，摧毁它。”
art_of_the_dragon_scale.text_en: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, it gets "When this hits a hero, put a -1{d} counter on an equipment they control. Then if it has 0{d}, destroy it."

aspect_of_tiger_body.text_zh: 连击——当此牌攻击时，若一张红色攻击行动牌是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动，并在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它。
aspect_of_tiger_body.text_en: Combo - When this attacks, if a red attack action card was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again and create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it this turn.

aspect_of_tiger_mind.text_zh: 连击——当此牌攻击时，若一张蓝色攻击行动牌是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动，并在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它。
aspect_of_tiger_mind.text_en: Combo - When this attacks, if a blue attack action card was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again and create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it this turn.

aspect_of_tiger_soul.text_zh: 连击——当此牌攻击时，若一张黄色攻击行动牌是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动，并在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它。
aspect_of_tiger_soul.text_en: Combo - When this attacks, if a yellow attack action card was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again and create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it this turn.

back_heel_kick.text_zh: 连击——若双旋风是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，当此牌在任意区域正面朝上且将获得力量时，改为其获得等量加1的力量。
back_heel_kick.text_en: Combo - If Twin Twisters was the last attack this combat chain, while this is face-up in any zone and would gain {p}, instead it gains that much plus 1.

be_like_water.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，选择刺拳、激涌打击或双旋风。此牌获得所选名称。
再动
be_like_water.text_en:
When this hits, you may pay {r}. If you do, choose Head Jab, Surging Strike, or Twin Twisters. This gains the chosen name.
Go again

become_the_bottle.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，选择战斗链上的一张牌。此牌获得所选牌的名称。
再动
become_the_bottle.text_en:
When this attacks, choose a card on the combat chain. This gets the chosen card's name.
Go again

become_the_cup.text_zh:
当你使用此牌时，选择一种颜色。此牌获得所选颜色。
再动
become_the_cup.text_en:
As you play this, choose a color. This gets the chosen color.
Go again

biting_breeze.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它。
再动
biting_breeze.text_en:
When this hits, create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it this turn.
Go again

bittering_thorns.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，你本回合的下一次攻击获得+1力量。
再动
bittering_thorns.text_en:
When this hits, your next attack this turn gets +1{p}.
Go again

blackout_kick.text_zh: 连击——若升膝突是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，失明踢获得+3力量。
blackout_kick.text_en: Combo - If Rising Knee Thrust was the last attack this combat chain, Blackout Kick gains +3{p}.

bleed_out.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 行动·攻击
bleed_out.text_zh:
此牌的使用费用减少X点资源，X为本战斗链中你用匕首造成的伤害总量。
再动
bleed_out.text_en:
Bleed Out costs X resource points less to play, where X is the total damage you've dealt with daggers this combat chain.
Go again

blessing_of_qi.text_zh: 在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌，然后在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。它获得+3力量，且本回合你可以使用它。
blessing_of_qi.text_en: At the start of your turn, destroy this, then create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. It gains +3{p} and you may play it this turn.

blood_drop.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
blood_drop.text_zh:
每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
再动
blood_drop.text_en:
This costs {r} less to play for each Draconic chain link you control.
Go again

blood_line.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
blood_line.text_zh:
每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
再动
blood_line.text_en:
This costs {r} less to play for each Draconic chain link you control.
Go again

blood_runs_deep.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
blood_runs_deep.text_zh:
每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
当此牌攻击英雄时，你控制的每把匕首对其造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中。摧毁这些匕首。
再动
blood_runs_deep.text_en:
This costs {r} less to play for each Draconic chain link you control.
When this attacks a hero, each dagger you control deals 1 damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit. Destroy the daggers.
Go again

bonds_of_ancestry.text_zh: 连击——若一张名称中含有阵风波的牌是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌的使用费用减少2点资源，并获得再动，以及“当此牌攻击时，你可以放逐你坟场中一张具有连击的牌。若如此做，从你的牌库中搜寻一张同名的牌，放逐它，然后洗牌。本战斗链中你可以使用它。”
bonds_of_ancestry.text_en: Combo - If a card with Gustwave in its name was the last attack this combat chain, this costs {r}{r} less to play, and has go again and "When this attacks, you may banish a card with combo from your graveyard. If you do, search your deck for a card with the same name, banish it, then shuffle. You may play it this combat chain."

brand_with_cinderclaw.text_zh:
本战斗链中你的下一次攻击除其原有类别外还视为龙裔。
再动
brand_with_cinderclaw.text_en:
Your next attack this combat chain is Draconic in addition to its other card types.
Go again

break_tide.text_zh: 连击——若激流冲或力量洪流是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，破潮获得+3力量、支配，以及“若破潮命中，放逐你牌库顶的一张牌。直到你的下一个回合结束，你可以使用它。”
break_tide.text_en: Combo - If Rushing River or Flood of Force was the last attack this combat chain, Break Tide gains +3{p}, dominate, and "If Break Tide hits, banish the top card of your deck. Until the end of your next turn, you may play it."

breed_anger.text_zh: 连击——当此牌攻击时，若卧虎是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动，并在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它。
breed_anger.text_en: Combo - When this attacks, if Crouching Tiger was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again and create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it this turn.

burning_blade_dance.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
burning_blade_dance.text_zh: 若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，你可以让你控制的目标匕首对其造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中。摧毁该匕首。”
burning_blade_dance.text_en: If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again and "When this hits a hero, you may have target dagger you control deal 1 damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit. Destroy the dagger."

chase_the_tail.text_zh: 连击——当此牌攻击时，若卧虎是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动，且本战斗链中你使用的下一张卧虎获得+3力量。
chase_the_tail.text_en: Combo - When this attacks, if Crouching Tiger was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again and the next Crouching Tiger you play this combat chain gets +3{p}.

cinderskin_devotion.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
cinderskin_devotion.text_zh: 若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动。
cinderskin_devotion.text_en: If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again.

combustion_point.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 攻击反应
combustion_point.text_zh:
目标龙裔或忍者攻击行动牌获得+1力量。
你可以放逐一张防御小于你控制的龙裔链环数量的非装备防御牌。
combustion_point.text_en:
Target Draconic or Ninja attack action card gains +1{p}.
You may banish a non-equipment defending card with {d} less than the number of Draconic chain links you control.

companion_of_the_claw.type_zh: 秘法 忍者 行动·攻击
companion_of_the_claw.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，若本回合你资源过一张蓝色牌，在你的手牌中创造一张卧虎。
再动
companion_of_the_claw.text_en:
When this attacks, if you've pitched a blue card this turn, create a Crouching Tiger in your hand.
Go again

concealed_blade.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 攻击反应
concealed_blade.text_zh: 目标刺客或忍者攻击行动牌获得+1力量，以及“当此牌命中时，从你的物品栏装备一把匕首。”
concealed_blade.text_en: Target Assassin or Ninja attack action card gains +1{p} and "When this hits, equip a dagger from your inventory."

crane_dance.text_zh: 连击——若魂珠打击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，鹤舞获得+1力量、再动，且不能被基础力量大于你控制的链环数量的攻击行动牌防御。
crane_dance.text_en: Combo - If Soulbead Strike was the last attack this combat chain, Crane Dance gains +1{p}, go again, and it can't be defended by attack action cards with base {p} greater than the number of chain links you control.

cut_through.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 行动·攻击
cut_through.text_zh: 若本战斗链中你用匕首命中过，此牌获得+1力量和再动。
cut_through.text_en: If you've hit with a dagger this combat chain, this gets +1{p} and go again.

cyclone_roundhouse.text_zh: 连击——若旋转轮踢是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得“在反应步骤开始时，从每个链环放逐一张随机防御牌。”
cyclone_roundhouse.text_en: Combo - If Spinning Wheel Kick was the last attack this combat chain, this has "At the beginning of the reaction step, banish a random defending card from each chain link."

deadly_duo.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，本战斗链中你使用的下一张基础力量为2或更低的攻击行动牌获得+2力量。
再动
deadly_duo.text_en:
When this hits, the next attack action card with 2 or less base {p} you play this combat chain gains +2 {p}.
Go again

demonstrate_devotion.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
demonstrate_devotion.text_zh: 若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，创造一个效忠衍生物。”
demonstrate_devotion.text_en: If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again and "When this attacks a hero, create a Fealty token."

descendent_gustwave.text_zh:
连击——若激涌打击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源并获得+2力量。
再动
descendent_gustwave.text_en:
Combo - If Surging Strike was the last attack this combat chain, this costs {r} less to play and has +2{p}.
Go again

devotion_never_dies.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，若一张龙裔攻击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，放逐此牌。若如此做，本回合你可以使用它。
再动
devotion_never_dies.text_en:
When this hits, if a Draconic attack was the last attack this combat chain, banish this. If you do, you may play it this turn.
Go again

dishonor.text_zh:
连击——若先祖纽带是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得+2力量。
当此牌命中英雄时，若你控制激涌打击、后继阵风波和先祖纽带，该英雄在剩余游戏中失去所有异能。
dishonor.text_en:
Combo - If Bonds of Ancestry was the last attack this combat chain, this has +2{p}.
When this hits a hero, if you control Surging Strike, Descendent Gustwave, and Bonds of Ancestry, that hero loses all abilities for the rest of the game.

display_loyalty.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
display_loyalty.text_zh: 若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，创造一个效忠衍生物。”
display_loyalty.text_en: If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again and "When this attacks a hero, create a Fealty token."

double_strike.text_zh:
当双重打击的链环结算时，放逐它。本战斗链中你可以使用它。若如此做，它失去此异能。
再动
double_strike.text_en:
When Double Strike's chain link resolves, banish it. You may play it this combat chain. If you do, it loses this ability.
Go again

dragon_power.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若其为龙裔，它获得+3力量。
dragon_power.text_en: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, it gets +3{p}.

dust_runner_outlaw.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击

edge_of_autumn.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击。再动
edge_of_autumn.text_en: Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack. Go again

enact_vengeance.text_zh: 连击——若秋之刃或一张名称中含有复仇的牌是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得“当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其军械库中的所有牌。”
enact_vengeance.text_en: Combo - If Edge of Autumn or a card with Vengeance in its name was the last attack this combat chain, this gets "When this hits a hero, destroy all cards in their arsenal."

enflame_the_firebrand.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
enflame_the_firebrand.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动；控制3个或更多，本战斗链中你的攻击视为龙裔；控制4个或更多，此牌获得+2力量。
enflame_the_firebrand.text_en: When this attacks, if you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again, 3 or more, your attacks are Draconic this combat chain, 4 or more, this gets +2{p}.

engulfing_flamewave.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
engulfing_flamewave.text_zh:
当吞噬火焰浪命中时，展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为费用小于你控制的龙裔链环数量的攻击行动牌，放逐它。本回合你可以使用它。
再动
engulfing_flamewave.text_en:
When Engulfing Flamewave hits, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an attack action card with cost less than number of Draconic chain links you control, banish it. You may play it this turn.
Go again

evasive_nageboshi.type_zh: 忍者 瞬间·Shuriken 物品
evasive_nageboshi.text_zh:
传奇
行动——支付1点资源，横置此牌，当战斗链关闭时摧毁此牌：攻击。再动
此牌不能被装备或反应牌防御。
evasive_nageboshi.text_en:
Legendary
Action - {r}, {t}, destroy this when the combat chain closes: Attack. Go again
This can't be defended by equipment or reaction cards.

feign_vengeance.text_zh:
当此链环结算时，若有牌防御此牌，抽一张牌。
再动
feign_vengeance.text_en:
When this chain link resolves, if there is a card defending this, draw a card.
Go again

find_center.text_zh: 连击——若鹤舞是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，寻真中心不能被费用少于你控制的链环数量的牌防御，并获得“若此牌命中，创造一个禅定衍生物。”
find_center.text_en: Combo - If Crane Dance was the last attack this combat chain, Find Center can't be defended by cards with {r} cost less than the number of chain links you control, and it gains "If this hits, create a Zen State token."

fire_tenet_strike_first.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，本战斗链中你的下一次龙裔攻击获得+1力量。
再动
fire_tenet_strike_first.text_en:
When this attacks, your next Draconic attack this combat chain gets +1{p}.
Go again

flex_claws.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。本回合你可以使用它。
再动
flex_claws.text_en:
When this hits, create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it this turn.
Go again

flic_flak.text_zh: 若本回合你用于防御的下一张牌具有连击，它获得+2防御。
flic_flak.text_en: If the next card you defend with this turn is a card with combo, it gains +2{d}.

flood_of_force.text_zh: 连击——若激流冲或力量洪流是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，当你用力量洪流攻击时，展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其具有连击，将其置入你的手牌，然后力量洪流获得+3力量和再动。
flood_of_force.text_en: Combo - If Rushing River or Flood of Force was the last attack this combat chain, when you attack with Flood of Force, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a card with combo, put it into your hand then Flood of Force gains +3{p} and go again.

fluster_fist.text_zh: 连击——若打开中心是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，每有一张本战斗链中命中过的攻击，慌乱之拳获得+1力量。
fluster_fist.text_en: Combo - If Open the Center was the last attack this combat chain, Fluster Fist gains +1{p} for each attack that has hit this combat chain.

flying_kick.text_zh: 若此牌是作为链环3或更高使用的，它获得+2力量。
flying_kick.text_en: If this was played as chain link 3 or higher, it gets +2{p}.

gentle_breeze.text_zh:
你的其他攻击具有1点基础力量。
再动
gentle_breeze.text_en:
Your other attacks have 1 base {p}.
Go again

grow_claws.text_zh:
若一张龙裔攻击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得+1力量。
再动
grow_claws.text_en:
If a Draconic attack was the last attack this combat chain, this gets +1{p}.
Go again

grow_wings.text_zh: 若一张龙裔攻击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动。
grow_wings.text_en: If a Draconic attack was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again.

growl.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，本战斗链中你使用的下一张卧虎获得+1力量。
再动
growl.text_en:
When this attacks, the next Crouching Tiger you play this combat chain gets +1{p}.
Go again

gustwave_of_the_second_wind.text_zh: 连击——若激涌打击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动。
gustwave_of_the_second_wind.text_en: Combo - If Surging Strike was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again.

harmonized_kodachi.type_zh: 忍者 武器·匕首 （单手）
harmonized_kodachi.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击

Draconic attacks you control have +1{p} while their base {p} is less than the number of Draconic chain links you control.
Go again

spring_tidings.text_zh:
本吉专精
当春日喜讯命中时，你控制的战斗链上每有一张另一张基础力量为2或更低的攻击行动牌，抽一张牌。
再动
spring_tidings.text_en:
Benji Specialization
When Spring Tidings hits, draw a card for each other attack action card with 2 or less base {p} you control on the combat chain.
Go again

stab_wound.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 行动·攻击
stab_wound.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，该英雄失去X点生命，X为本战斗链中匕首命中过的次数。
stab_wound.text_en: When this hits a hero, they lose X{h}, where X is the number of times a dagger has hit this combat chain.

stun_star.type_zh: 忍者 瞬间·Shuriken 物品
stun_star.text_zh:
传奇
行动——支付1点资源，横置此牌，当战斗链关闭时摧毁此牌：攻击。再动
当此牌命中英雄时，横置该英雄。
stun_star.text_en:
Legendary
Action - {r}, {t}, destroy this when the combat chain closes: Attack. Go again
When this hits a hero, {t} them.

swift_pickup.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，你可以将你坟场中的一个手里剑物品置于你的牌库底。若如此做，此牌获得+1力量。
再动
swift_pickup.text_en:
When this attacks, you may put a shuriken item from your graveyard on the bottom of your deck. If you do, this gets +1{p}.
Go again

tag_the_target.text_zh:
当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。
再动
tag_the_target.text_en:
When this hits a hero, mark them.
Go again

take_the_tempo.text_zh: 当掌握节奏命中时，若本战斗链中你命中过3次或更多，放逐你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为攻击行动牌，直到你的下一个回合结束你可以使用它。
take_the_tempo.text_en: When Take the Tempo hits, if you've hit 3 or more times this combat chain, banish the top card of your deck. If it's an attack action card, you may play it until the end of your next turn.

tempest_palm_gustwave.text_zh:
连击——若激涌打击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得+2力量。
若此牌作为链环3或更高使用，此牌获得再动。
tempest_palm_gustwave.text_en:
Combo - If Surging Strike was the last attack this combat chain, this gets +2{p}.
If this is played at chain link 3 or higher, this gets go again.

territorial_domain.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，若本回合你创造过一张卧虎，此牌获得+3防御。
territorial_domain.text_en: While this is defending, if you've created a Crouching Tiger this turn, this gets +3{d}.

throw_dagger.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 攻击反应
throw_dagger.text_zh: 你控制的、不在当前链环上的目标匕首对防御英雄造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中，你抽一张牌。摧毁该匕首。
throw_dagger.text_en: Target dagger you control that isn't on the active chain link deals 1 damage to the defending hero. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit and you draw a card. Destroy the dagger.

throw_yourself_at_them.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 行动·攻击
throw_yourself_at_them.text_zh:
当此牌攻击英雄时，你可以让你控制的目标匕首对其造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中。摧毁该匕首。
再动
throw_yourself_at_them.text_en:
When this attacks a hero, you may have target dagger you control deal 1 damage to them. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit. Destroy the dagger.
Go again

tiger_eye_reflex.text_zh:
伏击
当此牌防御时，在你的放逐区中创造一张卧虎。在你的下一个回合期间你可以使用它。
tiger_eye_reflex.text_en:
Ambush
When this defends, create a Crouching Tiger in your banished zone. You may play it during your next turn.

tiger_form_incantation.type_zh: 秘法 忍者 行动
tiger_form_incantation.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张卧虎获得+3力量。
若本回合你资源过一张蓝色牌，在你的手牌中创造一张卧虎。
再动
tiger_form_incantation.text_en:
The next Crouching Tiger you play this turn gets +3{p}.
If you've pitched a blue card this turn, create a Crouching Tiger in your hand.
Go again

tiger_swipe.text_zh: 连击——若卧虎是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得+2力量、再动，以及“当此牌命中时，在你的放逐区中创造X张卧虎，X为你控制的卧虎数量。本回合你可以使用它们。”
tiger_swipe.text_en: Combo - If Crouching Tiger was the last attack this combat chain, this has +2{p}, go again and "When this hits, create X Crouching Tigers in your banished zone, where X is the number of Crouching Tigers you control. You may play them this turn."

tiger_taming_khakkara.type_zh: 忍者 武器·法杖 （双手）
tiger_taming_khakkara.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：攻击。再动
当此牌攻击时，本战斗链中你使用的下一张卧虎获得+1力量。
tiger_taming_khakkara.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: Attack. Go again
When this attacks, the next Crouching Tiger you play this combat chain gets +1{p}.

tigrine_reflex.text_zh:
连击——若卧虎是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得+1力量和再动。
攻击反应——弃掉此牌：目标忍者攻击获得+1力量。在你的手牌中创造一张卧虎。
tigrine_reflex.text_en:
Combo - If Crouching Tiger was the last attack this combat chain, this gets +1{p} and go again.
Attack Reaction - Discard this: Target Ninja attack gets +1{p}. Create a Crouching Tiger in your hand.

tooth_and_claw.type_zh: 秘法 忍者 行动·攻击
tooth_and_claw.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，你可以展示你手牌中的任意数量卧虎。若你展示1张或更多，此牌获得再动。2张或更多，此牌获得+1力量。3张或更多，抽一张牌。
tooth_and_claw.text_en: When this attacks, you may reveal any number of Crouching Tigers from your hand. If you reveal 1 or more, this gets go again. 2 or more, this gets +1{p}. 3 or more, draw a card.

torrent_of_tempo.text_zh: 当此牌命中时，它获得再动。
torrent_of_tempo.text_en: When this hits, it gets go again.

trap_and_release.text_zh:
当此牌命中英雄时，标记该英雄。
再动
trap_and_release.text_en:
When this hits a hero, mark them.
Go again

twin_twisters.text_zh:
选择其一：
双旋风获得“当此牌命中时，本战斗链中你的下一次攻击获得+1力量。”
双旋风获得+1力量。
再动
twin_twisters.text_en:
Choose 1:

Twin Twisters gains "When this hits, your next attack this combat chain gains +1{p}."
Twin Twisters gains +1{p}.

Go again

untamed.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，本战斗链中你使用的下一张卧虎获得+1力量。
再动
untamed.text_en:
When this attacks, the next Crouching Tiger you play this combat chain gets +1{p}.
Go again

up_sticks_and_run.text_zh:
你可以从你的坟场中回收一把匕首。
你本回合的下一次匕首攻击获得+4力量。
再动
up_sticks_and_run.text_en:
You may retrieve a dagger from your graveyard.
Your next dagger attack this turn gets +4{p}.
Go again

vengeance_never_rests.text_zh: 连击——若秋之刃是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得再动，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，放逐它。本回合你可以使用它。”
vengeance_never_rests.text_en: Combo - If Edge of Autumn was the last attack this combat chain, this gets go again and "When this hits a hero, banish it. You may play it this turn."

visit_the_floating_dojo.text_zh:
卡兹专精
将你坟场中的一张激涌打击和一张具有连击的牌置于你的牌库顶和/或底。
visit_the_floating_dojo.text_en:
Katsu Specialization
Put a Surging Strike and a card with combo from your graveyard on the top and/or bottom of your deck.

wander_with_purpose.text_zh:
本吉专精
当此牌命中时，你可以弃一张费用为0的牌。若如此做，从你的牌库中搜寻一张具有连击的牌，放逐它，然后洗牌。本回合你可以使用它。
再动
wander_with_purpose.text_en:
Benji Specialization
When this hits, you may discard a card with cost 0. If you do, search your deck for a card with combo, banish it, then shuffle. You may play it this turn.
Go again

wax_off.text_zh: 若本回合你使用过上防，创造一个禅定衍生物。
wax_off.text_en: If you've played Wax On this turn, create a Zen State token.

wax_on.text_zh: 当上防防御费用为0的攻击行动牌时，它获得+2防御。
wax_on.text_en: While Wax On is defending an attack action card with cost 0, it gains +2{d}.

whelming_gustwave.text_zh: 连击——若激涌打击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，汹涌阵风波获得+1力量、再动，以及“若此牌命中，抽一张牌。”
whelming_gustwave.text_en: Combo - If Surging Strike was the last attack this combat chain, Whelming Gustwave gains +1{p}, go again, and "If this hits, draw a card."

whirling_mist_blossom.text_zh:
伊拉专精
当此牌命中且它是连续第二个或更高链环命中时，抽2张牌。
再动
whirling_mist_blossom.text_en:
Ira Specialization
When this hits and it's the second or higher chain link in a row to hit, draw 2 cards.
Go again

wind_chakra.type_zh: 秘法 忍者 行动
wind_chakra.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张卧虎获得+3力量。若本回合你超越过，改为它获得+5力量。
再动
wind_chakra.text_en:
The next Crouching Tiger you play this turn gets +3{p}. If you've transcended this turn, instead it gets +5{p}.
Go again

winds_of_eternity.text_zh: 连击——若永恒之风是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，永恒之风获得+2力量，以及“若此牌命中，将你在本战斗链上控制的所有名为百风的牌洗入你的牌库。”
winds_of_eternity.text_en: Combo - If Winds of Eternity was the last attack this combat chain, Winds of Eternity gains +2{p} and "If this hits, shuffle all cards named Hundred Winds you control on this combat chain into your deck."

wrath_of_retribution.text_zh:
传奇
每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
当此牌攻击时，你控制的匕首获得+1力量且本战斗链中启动费用减少1点资源。
再动
wrath_of_retribution.text_en:
Legendary
This costs {r} less to play for each Draconic chain link you control.
When this attacks, daggers you control get +1{p} and cost {r} less to activate this combat chain.
Go again

zen_state.text_zh:
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个平衡指示物。在你的行动阶段开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个平衡指示物，否则摧毁它。
若你将受到伤害，防止其中1点伤害。
zen_state.text_en:
This enters the arena with a balance counter. At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this unless you remove a balance counter from it.
If you would be dealt damage, prevent 1 of that damage.

zephyr_needle.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击。再动
当此牌被一张防御大于此武器攻击力量的牌防御时，当战斗链关闭时摧毁此牌。
zephyr_needle.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack. Go again
When this is defended by a card with {d} greater than this weapon attack's {p}, destroy this when the combat chain closes.
